####this can be used in case you have issues with TRAV and TRBV harmonization issues across different studies
##harmonize TRBV
```{r}
#subset either to human or mouse
df <- df[df$Species == "Human", ]
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

df2 <- df %>%
  mutate(
    TRBV_harmonized = TRBV %>%
      str_trim() %>%
      na_if("NA") %>%
      # 1) normalize leading zeros after TRBV (family)
      str_replace_all("^TRBV0+(?=\\d)", "TRBV") %>%
      # 2) normalize leading zeros after '-' (gene)
      str_replace_all("-(0+)(?=\\d)", "-") %>%
      # 3) normalize leading zeros after '/' when the second part is missing TRBV
      #    e.g. TRBV3-1/03-2 -> TRBV3-1/3-2, TRBV06-02/06-03 -> TRBV6-2/6-3
      str_replace_all("/0+(?=\\d)", "/"),
    
    TRBV_IMGT_nomenclature_compliant = case_when(
      is.na(TRBV_harmonized) ~ FALSE,
      str_detect(TRBV_harmonized, "/") ~ FALSE,                     # ambiguous
      str_detect(TRBV_harmonized, "^TRBV\\d+$") ~ FALSE,            # family-only
      str_detect(TRBV_harmonized, "^TRBV\\d+-\\d+(\\*\\d+|\\*)?$") ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    )
  )

```


```{r}
trbv_map <- df2 %>%

  arrange(TRBV_IMGT_nomenclature_compliant, Original)


```

##put a flag for TRAV compliance
```{r}
# --- Harmonize TRAV ---

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

df2 <- df2 %>%
  mutate(
    # --- Harmonize TRAV ---
    TRAV_harmonized = TRAV %>%
      str_trim() %>%
      na_if("NA") %>%
      # 1) Normalize leading zeros after TRAV (Family level)
      #    e.g., TRAV01 -> TRAV1
      str_replace_all("^TRAV0+(?=\\d)", "TRAV") %>%
      # 2) Normalize leading zeros after '-' (Gene level)
      #    e.g., TRAV1-01 -> TRAV1-1
      str_replace_all("-(0+)(?=\\d)", "-") %>%
      # 3) Normalize leading zeros in ambiguous matches (after '/')
      #    e.g. TRAV1-1/01-2 -> TRAV1-1/1-2
      str_replace_all("/0+(?=\\d)", "/") %>%
      # 4) Special handling for Delta Variable (/DV) leading zeros if present
      #    e.g. TRAV14/DV04 -> TRAV14/DV4
      str_replace_all("/DV0+(?=\\d)", "/DV"),

    # --- Update Compliance Flag to check the NEW column ---
    TRAV_IMGT_nomenclature_compliant = case_when(
      is.na(TRAV_harmonized) ~ FALSE,
      # Check for ambiguous slash that isn't a valid /DV
      str_detect(TRAV_harmonized, "/(?!DV)") ~ FALSE, 
      str_detect(TRAV_harmonized, "^TRAV\\d+$") ~ FALSE,                  # family-only
      # Regex allows for optional gene (-d) and optional DV segment (/DVd)
      str_detect(TRAV_harmonized, "^TRAV\\d+(-\\d+)?(/DV\\d+)?$") ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    )
  )
```

###Create a Jaccard overlap matrix
```{r}
#2️⃣ Build Category-level CDR3β sets
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

cdr3b_sets <- df2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(CDR3.beta.aa)) %>%
  group_by(Category) %>%
  summarise(
    CDR3b_set = list(unique(CDR3.beta.aa)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
#3️⃣ Jaccard overlap matrix
jaccard <- function(a, b) {
  length(intersect(a, b)) / length(union(a, b))
}
pathologies <- cdr3b_sets$Category

jaccard_mat <- matrix(
  nrow = length(pathologies),
  ncol = length(pathologies),
  dimnames = list(pathologies, pathologies)
)

for (i in seq_along(pathologies)) {
  for (j in seq_along(pathologies)) {
    jaccard_mat[i, j] <- jaccard(
      cdr3b_sets$CDR3b_set[[i]],
      cdr3b_sets$CDR3b_set[[j]]
    )
  }
}

jaccard_mat
#4️⃣ Cluster pathologies by CDR3β overlap
dist_mat <- as.dist(1 - jaccard_mat)

hc <- hclust(dist_mat, method = "average")


```




###plot Jaccard overlap for CDR3b aa
```{r}

off_diag <- jaccard_mat[upper.tri(jaccard_mat)]
off_diag_pos <- off_diag[off_diag > 0]
summary(off_diag_pos)

library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)

pmin <- min(off_diag_pos)
pmed <- as.numeric(quantile(off_diag_pos, 0.5))
pmax <- max(off_diag_pos)

col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(0, pmin, pmed, pmax),
  c("white", "mistyrose", "orange", "red")
)

jaccard_plot <- jaccard_mat
diag(jaccard_plot) <- NA

cell_fun <- function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill) {
  val <- jaccard_plot[i, j]
  if (!is.na(val) && val > 0) {
    grid::grid.text(sprintf("%.3g", val), x, y,
                    gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8))
  }
}

library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(stringr) 

# 1. Formatting: Wrap long row names
rownames(jaccard_plot) <- str_wrap(rownames(jaccard_plot), width = 30)

# 2. Define the cell function with larger font
cell_fun_custom = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
  if(!is.na(jaccard_plot[i, j])) {
    grid.text(sprintf("%.5f", jaccard_plot[i, j]), 
              x, y, 
              gp = gpar(fontsize = 12)) # increased font size
  }
}

Heatmap(
  jaccard_plot,
  name = "Jaccard",
  col = col_fun,
  
  # We use the clustering object (hc) to determine the ORDER of rows/cols...
  cluster_rows = hc,
  cluster_columns = hc,
  # ...but we set the width/height of the dendrogram to ZERO to hide it.
  show_row_dend = FALSE,
  show_column_dend = FALSE,
  # -----------------------

  row_names_side = "left",
  
  # Automatically reserve space for the now-wrapped long labels
  row_names_max_width = max_text_width(rownames(jaccard_plot), 
                                       gp = gpar(fontsize = 12)),
  
  column_names_rot = 45,
  na_col = "white",
  cell_fun = cell_fun_custom,
  rect_gp = grid::gpar(col = "grey80", lwd = 0.5),
  column_title = "CDR3β Jaccard overlap between pathologies"
)
```

##table generation for figure 3B
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)

# 1) Presence table
cdr3_presence <- df2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(CDR3.beta.aa)) %>%
  distinct(Category, CDR3.beta.aa)

# 2) Count publicness (#pathologies per CDR3β)
cdr3_counts <- cdr3_presence %>%
  count(CDR3.beta.aa, name = "n_pathologies")

# Choose threshold or top N
k_public <- 2   # try 3 or 4
topN <- 60      # or use top N to keep plot readable

cdr3_top <- cdr3_counts %>%
  filter(n_pathologies >= k_public) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_pathologies)) %>%
  slice_head(n = topN) %>%
  pull(CDR3.beta.aa)


# 3) Build a binary matrix: rows=CDR3β, cols=Pathology
mat_df <- cdr3_presence %>%
  filter(CDR3.beta.aa %in% cdr3_top) %>%
  mutate(present = 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Category, values_from = present, values_fill = 0)

mat <- as.matrix(mat_df[,-1])
rownames(mat) <- mat_df$CDR3.beta.aa

# 4) Add row annotation: publicness
row_pub <- cdr3_counts %>%
  filter(CDR3.beta.aa %in% rownames(mat)) %>%
  distinct(CDR3.beta.aa, n_pathologies) %>%
  tibble::deframe()

row_ha <- rowAnnotation(
  n_pathologies = row_pub[rownames(mat)],
  col = list(n_pathologies = colorRamp2(
    c(min(row_pub), max(row_pub)),
    c("lightgrey", "black")
  ))
)

##generate summary statistics to be used in complexheatmap

heatmap_seq_df <- df2 %>%
  # 1. Keep only the sequences that made it into your heatmap
  filter(CDR3.beta.aa %in% cdr3_top) %>%
  
  # 2. Group by sequence to calculate stats per CDR3
  group_by(CDR3.beta.aa) %>%
  
  # 3. Create the summary columns
  summarise(
    # a) & b) PubMed IDs: List them and count them
    PubMed_IDs = paste(unique(`PubMed ID`), collapse = "; "),
    n_PubMed_IDs = n_distinct(`PubMed ID`),
    
    # c) & d) Categories: List them and count them
    Categories = paste(unique(Category), collapse = "; "),
    n_Categories = n_distinct(Category)
  ) %>%
  
  # Optional: Arrange by most shared, then by most citations
  arrange(desc(n_Categories), desc(n_PubMed_IDs))

# View the result
print(heatmap_seq_df)
```

###figure 3B
```{r}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(dplyr)
library(RColorBrewer)

# --- 1. Data Prep ---
stats_df <- heatmap_seq_df %>%
  filter(CDR3.beta.aa %in% rownames(mat)) %>%
  arrange(factor(CDR3.beta.aa, levels = rownames(mat)))

# --- 2. Define Colors & Order ---
# Define the strict order for Pathologies (Columns)
pathology_order <- colnames(mat) 

# Assign colors to this specific order
pathology_colors <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = length(pathology_order), name = "Dark2")
names(pathology_colors) <- pathology_order

# Colors for stats
col_publicness <- colorRamp2(c(2, 4), c("#FFEDA0", "#F03B20")) 
col_papers     <- colorRamp2(c(0, max(stats_df$n_PubMed_IDs)), c("white", "steelblue"))

# --- 3. Build Annotations ---

# Top Annotation: Pathology Bar
ha_top <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  # FORCE the factor levels to match your column order so Legend doesn't alphabetize
  Category = factor(colnames(mat), levels = pathology_order),
  col = list(Category = pathology_colors),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  annotation_legend_param = list(Category = list(title = "Pathology", at = pathology_order))
)

# Right Annotation: Stats Blocks with Numbers
ha_right <- rowAnnotation(
  
  "N Pathologies" = anno_simple(
    stats_df$n_Categories, 
    col = col_publicness,
    pch = as.character(stats_df$n_Categories), # Add number
    pt_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9),
    height = unit(5, "mm")
  ),
  
  "N Studies" = anno_simple(
    stats_df$n_PubMed_IDs, 
    col = col_papers,
    # HERE is the change: Add the number for Papers too
    pch = as.character(stats_df$n_PubMed_IDs), 
    pt_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9),
    height = unit(5, "mm")
  ),
  
  gap = unit(2, "mm")
)

# --- 4. Plot ---
cell_size <- 0.5 
ht_width  <- unit(ncol(mat) * cell_size, "cm")
ht_height <- unit(nrow(mat) * cell_size, "cm")


tiff("shared_CDR3b_hunam", units="in", width=9, height = 20, res=200)
Heatmap(
  mat,
  name = "Present",
  col = c("0" = "white", "1" = "grey30"),
  
  width = ht_width,
  height = ht_height,
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "grey90", lwd = 1),
  
  # Column Settings
  cluster_columns = FALSE,    # <--- FALSE ensures Legend matches Top Bar order
  column_order = pathology_order, # Explicitly use our order
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  top_annotation = ha_top,
  
  # Row Settings
  cluster_rows = TRUE, 
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  right_annotation = ha_right,
  
  column_title = paste0("Shared CDR3β Sequences ")
)
dev.off()
```

###Fig 3C
#network GLIPH2 analysis-human
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(turboGliph) # Assuming you have this installed

# --- 1. Filter and Format Input Data ---
# We rename columns to standard GLIPH nomenclature
gliph_table <- df2 %>%
  # Filter out missing CDR3s
  filter(!is.na(CDR3.beta.aa), CDR3.beta.aa != "") %>%
  
  # Select and Rename for GLIPH
  select(
    CDR3b = CDR3.beta.aa, 
    patient = Category # Mapping 'Category' to 'patient' lets GLIPH track groups
  ) %>%
  distinct() 

# --- 2. Run TurboGliph ---
gliph_results <- turboGliph::gliph_combined(
  cdr3_sequences = gliph_table,
  lcminove = c(100, 10, 2), 
  lcminp = 0.05, 
  # Ensure we look for local motifs of size 2, 3, and 4
  motif_length = c(2, 3, 4),

  local_method = "fisher",
  boost_local_significance = TRUE,
  global_method = "fisher",
  clustering_method = "GLIPH2.0", 
  scoring_method = "GLIPH2.0",
  n_cores = 1,
    cluster_min_size = 3
)
```


```{r}
library(igraph)
library(ggraph)
library(tidygraph)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(stringr)

# --- 1. Identify the "Seed" Clusters ---
seeds <- gliph_results$cluster_properties %>%
  filter(cluster_size >= 10) %>%
  arrange(desc(cluster_size)) %>%
  mutate(Cluster_ID = row_number()) # Assign ID

# Prepare the Global Edge List (Used to find secondary connections/branches)
all_edges_raw <- gliph_results$cluster_properties %>%
  select(tag, members) %>%
  separate_rows(members, sep = " ") %>%
  rename(Motif = tag, CDR3 = members)

# --- 2. Build Independent Networks ---
# We build a separate edge list for each cluster, tagging nodes to prevent merging

master_edges <- data.frame()

for (i in 1:nrow(seeds)) {
  
  # A. Get the Main Hub and its Members
  seed_motif <- seeds$tag[i]
  seed_id <- seeds$Cluster_ID[i]
  
  # Get the members of this specific cluster
  members <- unlist(strsplit(seeds$members[i], " "))
  
  # B. Find ALL connections for these members (Branching)
  # We look at the global list: What OTHER motifs do these members have?
  sub_edges <- all_edges_raw %>%
    filter(CDR3 %in% members)
  
  #  Make IDs Unique

  sub_edges <- sub_edges %>%
    mutate(
      from_node = paste0(Motif, "__", seed_id),  # Unique Motif ID
      to_node = paste0(CDR3, "__", seed_id),     # Unique CDR3 ID
      Original_Motif = Motif,
      Original_CDR3 = CDR3,
      Cluster_Group = seed_id
    ) %>%
    select(from_node, to_node, Original_Motif, Original_CDR3, Cluster_Group)
  
  # D. Add to Master List
  master_edges <- bind_rows(master_edges, sub_edges)
}

# --- 3. Build Node Metadata ---

# Get base metadata from df2
cdr3_meta <- df2 %>%
  group_by(CDR3.beta.aa) %>%
  summarise(
    Category = ifelse(n_distinct(Category) > 1, "Shared/Mixed", first(Category)),
    size_metric = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Create Node List for the Graph
nodes_unique <- data.frame(name = unique(c(master_edges$from_node, master_edges$to_node))) %>%
  separate(name, into = c("Real_Name", "Cluster_ID"), sep = "__", remove = FALSE) %>%
  left_join(cdr3_meta, by = c("Real_Name" = "CDR3.beta.aa")) %>%
  mutate(
    # Determine Type based on whether it matched a CDR3 in df2
    type = ifelse(is.na(size_metric), "Motif", "CDR3"),
    # Fill NAs for Motifs
    Category = ifelse(type == "Motif", "Motif", Category),
    size_metric = ifelse(type == "Motif", 1, size_metric)
  )
```



```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)

# --- 1. Prepare Reference Data ---

all_edges_raw <- gliph_results$cluster_properties %>%
  select(tag, members) %>%
  separate_rows(members, sep = " ") %>%
  rename(Motif = tag, CDR3 = members)

# Get the Top  Seeds
seeds <- gliph_results$cluster_properties %>%
  filter(cluster_size >= 10) %>%
  arrange(desc(cluster_size)) %>%
  mutate(Cluster_ID = row_number())

# --- 2. The Expansion Loop ---
expanded_table <- data.frame()

for (i in 1:nrow(seeds)) {
  
  # A. Define the Core
  current_seed_motif <- seeds$tag[i]
  current_cluster_id <- seeds$Cluster_ID[i]
  
  # Core Members (The ones in the plot)
  core_members <- unlist(strsplit(seeds$members[i], " "))
  
  # B. Find Bridges (Secondary Motifs held by Core Members)
  # We look for ANY motif attached to a Core Member
  member_connections <- all_edges_raw %>%
    filter(CDR3 %in% core_members)
  
  secondary_motifs <- unique(member_connections$Motif)
  # Exclude the seed itself from being a "bridge" to itself
  secondary_motifs <- setdiff(secondary_motifs, current_seed_motif)
  
  # C. Find Neighbors (The Expansion)
  # Find ALL CDR3s connected to these Secondary Motifs
  neighbor_connections <- all_edges_raw %>%
    filter(Motif %in% secondary_motifs)
  
  # D. Classify the Sequences
  # We analyze every unique CDR3 found in this extended network
  all_involved_cdr3s <- unique(c(core_members, neighbor_connections$CDR3))
  
  # Build a mini-table for this cluster
  cluster_profile <- data.frame(CDR3 = all_involved_cdr3s) %>%
    mutate(
      Cluster_ID = current_cluster_id,
      Seed_Motif = current_seed_motif,
      
      # CLASSIFICATION:
      # Core = Has the Seed Motif (is in the original member list)
      # Neighbor = Does NOT have the Seed Motif (brought in by a bridge)
      Type = ifelse(CDR3 %in% core_members, "Core Member", "Neighbor/Deviation")
    )
  
  # E. Add Connectivity Details 
  # For each CDR3, list the motifs that link it to this cluster
  
  # 1. Get all motifs for these CDR3s
  relevant_edges <- all_edges_raw %>%
    filter(CDR3 %in% all_involved_cdr3s) %>%
    filter(Motif %in% c(current_seed_motif, secondary_motifs)) # Only count relevant motifs
  
  # 2. Summarize motifs per CDR3
  motif_summaries <- relevant_edges %>%
    group_by(CDR3) %>%
    summarise(
      Connected_Motifs = paste(unique(Motif), collapse = " + "),
      N_Motifs = n_distinct(Motif),
      # Check if it connects to the Seed
      Has_Seed = any(Motif == current_seed_motif)
    )
  
  # Join back
  cluster_profile <- cluster_profile %>%
    left_join(motif_summaries, by = "CDR3") %>%
    # Double check the classification
    mutate(Type = ifelse(Has_Seed, "Core Member", "Neighbor/Deviation"))
  
  # Add to Master
  expanded_table <- bind_rows(expanded_table, cluster_profile)
}

# --- 3. Add Metadata (Publicness/Pathology) ---
# Join with your df2 metadata
final_expansion_table <- expanded_table %>%
  left_join(cdr3_meta, by = c("CDR3" = "CDR3.beta.aa")) %>%
  select(
    Cluster_ID,
    Seed_Motif,
    Type,
    CDR3,
    Category,
    Publicness = size_metric,
    N_Motifs,
    Connected_Motifs
  ) %>%
  arrange(Cluster_ID, Type, desc(Publicness))

# --- 4. View and Export ---
print(head(final_expansion_table, 20))

# Save
write.csv(final_expansion_table, "GLIPH2_Cluster_Expansion_Analysis_human.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```





```{r}
library(igraph)
library(ggraph)
library(tidygraph)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(stringr)

# --- 1. SETTINGS ---
#change numbers according to how many you want to visualize
N_CLUSTERS <- 5               
NODE_SIZE_RANGE <- c(1, 4)  # Reduced range for smaller bubbles
EDGE_WIDTH <- 0.4
FONT_SIZE <- 10
MOTIF_SIZE <- 1             # Standard size for ALL motifs (Seed & Secondary)

# --- 2. PREPARE DATA ---
all_edges_raw <- gliph_results$cluster_properties %>%
  select(tag, members) %>%
  mutate(members = trimws(members)) %>% 
  separate_rows(members, sep = " ") %>%
  rename(Motif = tag, CDR3 = members) %>%
  filter(!is.na(CDR3) & CDR3 != "") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Motif) & Motif != "")

seeds <- gliph_results$cluster_properties %>%
  filter(cluster_size >= 10) %>%
  arrange(desc(cluster_size)) %>%
  mutate(Cluster_ID = row_number())

# --- 3. LOOP: BUILD TOP CLUSTERS ---
master_edges <- data.frame()
master_nodes_meta <- data.frame()
csv_export_list <- list()

message(paste("Processing Top", N_CLUSTERS, "Clusters..."))

for (i in 1:N_CLUSTERS) {
  
  target_seed_row <- seeds[i, ]
  current_seed <- target_seed_row$tag
  seed_id <- target_seed_row$Cluster_ID
  
  core_members <- unlist(strsplit(target_seed_row$members, " "))
  core_members <- trimws(core_members)
  core_members <- core_members[core_members != "" & !is.na(core_members)]
  
  # Level 1: Core
  l1_edges <- data.frame(
    from = current_seed, to = core_members,
    type = "Core_Connection", length_factor = 0.1 
  )
  
  # Level 2: Bridges
  core_connections <- all_edges_raw %>%
    filter(CDR3 %in% core_members) %>%
    filter(Motif != current_seed) 
  
  if(nrow(core_connections) > 0) {
    l2_edges <- core_connections %>%
      rename(from = Motif, to = CDR3) %>%
      group_by(from) %>% slice(1) %>% ungroup() %>%
      mutate(type = "Bridge_Connection", length_factor = 50.0)
    
    # Level 3: Neighbors
    secondary_motifs <- unique(l2_edges$from)
    neighbor_connections <- all_edges_raw %>%
      filter(Motif %in% secondary_motifs) %>%
      filter(!CDR3 %in% core_members) 
    
    if(nrow(neighbor_connections) > 0) {
      l3_edges <- neighbor_connections %>%
        rename(from = Motif, to = CDR3) %>%
        group_by(to) %>% slice_sample(n = 1) %>% ungroup() %>%
        mutate(type = "Neighbor_Connection", length_factor = 0.1)
    } else { l3_edges <- data.frame() }
  } else { l2_edges <- data.frame(); l3_edges <- data.frame() }
  
  # Combine
  cluster_label_text <- paste0("#", seed_id, ": ", current_seed)
  cluster_edges <- bind_rows(l1_edges, l2_edges, l3_edges) %>%
    mutate(
      from_node = paste0(from, "__", seed_id),
      to_node = paste0(to, "__", seed_id),
      Cluster_Label = cluster_label_text
    ) %>%
    select(from_node, to_node, type, length_factor, Cluster_Label)
  
  master_edges <- bind_rows(master_edges, cluster_edges)
  
  # Metadata
  unique_nodes <- unique(c(cluster_edges$from_node, cluster_edges$to_node))
  node_df <- data.frame(name = unique_nodes) %>%
    separate(name, into = c("Real_Name", "Cluster_ID"), sep = "__", remove = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(is_seed = Real_Name == current_seed, Cluster_Label = cluster_label_text)
  
  master_nodes_meta <- bind_rows(master_nodes_meta, node_df)
  
  # CSV Data
  nodes_in_plot_real <- node_df$Real_Name[!node_df$Real_Name %in% all_edges_raw$Motif]
  detailed_connections <- all_edges_raw %>%
    filter(CDR3 %in% nodes_in_plot_real) %>%
    group_by(CDR3) %>%
    summarise(
      All_Connected_Motifs = paste(unique(Motif), collapse = ", "),
      Num_Motifs = n_distinct(Motif),
      Has_Seed = any(Motif == current_seed),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  cluster_csv <- node_df %>%
    filter(!Real_Name %in% all_edges_raw$Motif) %>%
    left_join(df2, by = c("Real_Name" = "CDR3.beta.aa")) %>%
    group_by(Real_Name) %>%
    summarise(
      Category = ifelse(n_distinct(Category) > 1, "Shared/Mixed", first(Category)),
      Shared_Count = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    left_join(detailed_connections, by = c("Real_Name" = "CDR3")) %>%
    mutate(Cluster_Rank = seed_id, Seed_Motif = current_seed,
           Role = ifelse(Has_Seed, "Core Member", "Neighbor (Deviation)")) %>%
    select(Cluster_Rank, Seed_Motif, CDR3=Real_Name, Role, Category, Shared_Count, Num_Motifs, All_Connected_Motifs)
  
  csv_export_list[[i]] <- cluster_csv
}

# --- 4. BUILD & LAYOUT ---
edges_clean <- data.frame(
  from = master_edges$from_node, to = master_edges$to_node,
  type = master_edges$type, length_factor = master_edges$length_factor,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

cdr3_counts <- df2 %>%
  group_by(CDR3.beta.aa) %>%
  summarise(
    Category = ifelse(n_distinct(Category) > 1, "Shared/Mixed", first(Category)),
    size_metric = n(), .groups = "drop"
  )

nodes_clean <- master_nodes_meta %>%
  distinct(name, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  left_join(cdr3_counts, by = c("Real_Name" = "CDR3.beta.aa")) %>%
  mutate(
    type = ifelse(is.na(size_metric), "Motif", "CDR3"),
    Category = ifelse(type == "Motif", "Motif", Category),
    size_metric = ifelse(type == "Motif", 1, size_metric)
  )

valid_nodes <- nodes_clean$name
edges_clean <- edges_clean[edges_clean$from %in% valid_nodes & edges_clean$to %in% valid_nodes, ]

g_master <- graph_from_data_frame(d = edges_clean, vertices = nodes_clean, directed = FALSE)
g_master <- as_tbl_graph(g_master)

# Decompose & Layout
subgraphs <- decompose(g_master)
get_id <- function(g) as.numeric(sub(".*__", "", V(g)$name[1]))
subgraphs <- subgraphs[order(sapply(subgraphs, get_id))]

coords_master <- data.frame()
labels_master <- data.frame() # New DF to store Title positions
PLOT_WIDTH <- 60
x_cursor <- 0; y_cursor <- 0; row_max_height <- 0; padding <- 20.0 # Increased padding for Titles

message("Calculating layouts...")
for (g in subgraphs) {
  E(g)$length_factor <- as.numeric(E(g)$length_factor)
  E(g)$length_factor[is.na(E(g)$length_factor)] <- 1.0
  
  l <- tryCatch({
    layout_with_graphopt(g, charge = 0.02, spring.length = E(g)$length_factor, spring.constant = 1)
  }, error = function(e) { layout_with_fr(g, weights = 1/E(g)$length_factor) })
  
  l[,1] <- scales::rescale(l[,1], to = c(-1, 1)) * sqrt(vcount(g))
  l[,2] <- scales::rescale(l[,2], to = c(-1, 1)) * sqrt(vcount(g))
  
  x_min <- min(l[,1]); x_max <- max(l[,1])
  y_min <- min(l[,2]); y_max <- max(l[,2])
  w <- x_max - x_min; h <- y_max - y_min
  
  if ((x_cursor + w) > PLOT_WIDTH) {
    x_cursor <- 0; y_cursor <- y_cursor - row_max_height - padding; row_max_height <- 0
  }
  if (h > row_max_height) row_max_height <- h
  
  l[,1] <- l[,1] - x_min + x_cursor
  l[,2] <- l[,2] - y_max + y_cursor
  
  # Calculate Title Position (Top Center of this cluster)
  title_x <- mean(range(l[,1]))
  title_y <- max(l[,2]) + 3.0 # Shift slightly above the highest node
  
  labels_master <- bind_rows(labels_master, data.frame(
    x = title_x, y = title_y, 
    label = unique(V(g)$Cluster_Label)[1]
  ))
  
  coords_master <- bind_rows(coords_master, data.frame(name = V(g)$name, x = l[,1], y = l[,2]))
  x_cursor <- x_cursor + w + padding
}

# --- 5. PLOT ---
nodes_in_plot <- coords_master$name
g_final <- g_master %>% activate(nodes) %>% filter(name %in% nodes_in_plot)
coords_final <- coords_master %>% arrange(match(name, V(g_final)$name))
layout_matrix <- as.matrix(coords_final[, c("x", "y")])

cats <- setdiff(unique(nodes_clean$Category), "Motif")
my_pal <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(8, "Set1"))(length(cats))
names(my_pal) <- cats
my_colors <- c(my_pal, "Motif" = "black") 
if("Shared/Mixed" %in% names(my_colors)) my_colors["Shared/Mixed"] <- "grey50"

p <- ggraph(g_final, layout = layout_matrix) + 
  geom_edge_link(alpha = 0.3, color = "grey60", width = EDGE_WIDTH) + 
  
  # CDR3 Nodes
  geom_node_point(aes(filter = type == "CDR3", color = Category, size = size_metric), 
                  alpha = 0.9) +
  
  # Secondary Motifs (Shape 19 = Circle) - Size Fixed
  geom_node_point(aes(filter = type == "Motif" & !is_seed), 
                  color = "black", size = MOTIF_SIZE, shape = 19) + 
  
  # Seed Motifs (Shape 18 = Diamond) - Size Fixed (Same as above)
  geom_node_point(aes(filter = type == "Motif" & is_seed), 
                  color = "black", size = MOTIF_SIZE*1.5, shape = 18) + 
  
  # CLUSTER TITLES (Placed manually on top)
  geom_text(data = labels_master, aes(x = x, y = y, label = label), 
            inherit.aes = FALSE, fontface = "bold", size = 5) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = my_colors) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = NODE_SIZE_RANGE, name = "Shared CDR3s") + 
  
  theme_void() + 
  labs(title = "Top Specificity Clusters") +
  theme(legend.position = "right", text = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE))

print(p)

ggsave("Top_Clusters_Final_hunam.pdf", plot = p, width = 9, height = 15, limitsize = FALSE)
final_csv <- bind_rows(csv_export_list) %>% arrange(Cluster_Rank, desc(Shared_Count))
write.csv(final_csv, "Top_Clusters_Composition_hunam.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
